text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Assets of offshore banking units in Bahrain stood at $67 billion at the end of 1996.
- Bahrain's pension fund commission to pay out 20 percent more in benefits in 1997 than in 1996.
- Bahrain joins an international campaign to protect coral reefs around the world.
- Bahrain to stage a roadshow in India this summer, to promote the island.
- A Kuwaiti-Egyptian firm offers shares for subscription in Arab states, including Bahrain.
